name: Follow the line
title: What are you facing this week?
note: Follow the line carousel posted; all verses checked
caption:
Which line did you follow? Tell us the number.

Whatever this week holds for you, a hard choice, a worry, a long season of waiting or a fresh loss, you do not have to carry it alone. God is generous with wisdom, close to the hurting, and faithful to give strength to the tired.

James 1:5, Isaiah 40:31, Psalm 34:18, Psalm 56:3 (BSB)

Save this for the week ahead.
